definitions.description: The system returns PASS for an item whose expected gate requires ABSTAIN.
The cited source or chunk is absent from the evidence snapshot.
The cited authority cannot support the legal proposition at the required tier.
The claim attributes a proposition to the wrong statutory or policy section.
A purported quotation does not occur in the cited evidence under the declared normalization.
The evidence does not support the proposition even though its words may overlap.
The authority was not effective on the claim's as-of date.
The claim removes a material exception or limiting condition from the authority.
The requested or stated remedy exceeds the decision-maker's evidenced powers.
Cantonese or Chinese wording changes the legally material meaning of the source.
The authority is outside British Columbia or otherwise outside the stated jurisdiction.
The claim strengthens may/can language into must, or otherwise changes the authority's modal force.
The system abstains only because of harmless punctuation, spacing, or wording variation.
The system downgrades a fair favourable use of an authority only because it prefers a defensive formulation or non-material adverse context.
The system misses a source-supported opportunity to remove a helmet or state a materially stronger favourable proposition.
The system proposes stronger wording that exceeds the cited evidence or changes a legally material fact, quotation, condition, or force.
The system fails to preserve meaning across Cantonese and English code-switching.
